title: WP-M2-00 canonical schema: provision identity, provenance, kind, definitions
summary: Before wiring up the schema-first render path, three canonical shapes must be locked: (1) provision-instance identity (stable across reingest) plus excerpt IDs; (2) provenance bundle (source doc, page, offset, extractor plus version, model, prompt hash, run_id) plus extractor stamp visible on card; (3) Provision.kind field with values standard | definition | cross-reference, enabling definitions-as-provisions with cross-references. Approving unblocks WP-M2-00 Steps 2-8 to write the actual PRs. The evidence also carries the useful M2-02 discovery from PR #186: there are currently 40 deals, zero provision_cards rows, and no card-backed review branch.

evidence.label: Proposed canonical shapes and M2-02 discovery

choices.label: Approve all three shapes as proposed
